svg.text: Our layout vs Apple Magic Keyboard, US (ghost), aligned on F, units in mm
F key, centred on the same point in both

Magic Keyboard: measured on a UK keyboard (19.0 mm key pitch, 18.5 mm row pitch, 16 x 15.5 mm caps, key width = n x 19 - 3 mm), converted to US. Up and down share one key height with a 3 mm gap (assumed).
